origin_paragraphs: COL5A2’s unexpected A support is strongly dependent on read ends. A bounded search of selected representative sequences also found local gap-placement alternatives at APOD, EXOC3 and DHFR: first-best nominated ordinary alignments placed the queried base in an insertion or at a nearby reference position. These alternatives sometimes scored below the original splice-path model containing the unexpected allele. They demonstrate ambiguity, not a proven correction or preferred read origin.

The PABPC1 discrepancies remain unresolved. All 65 baseline query names supporting G at chr8:100705591 also support C at chr8:100705604 in the same qualifying alignment. The two sites therefore share substantial read support and cannot be treated as independent checks. Representative sequences are not independent molecules; the bounded reference search cannot establish allele origin.
origin_editorial_review: Approved by read-origin reviewer; shared-support qualification applied.
